title: GeoLS: an Intensity-based, Geodesic Soft Labeling for Image Segmentation
mechanism: Soft labels from a geodesic distance transform on image intensity, so label mass spreads along similar intensities and not across edges.
adaptation: Geodesic distance on the EL image from each crack label pixel: soft crack mass flows along the dark crack ridge and not over bright silicon, recentring labels that sit > 1 px off the darkest ridge (half of label points). Same for inactive borders. Combine with JML/DML.
min_experiment: Pre-check without training: on train cells, measure distance of GeoLS soft-label peak vs raw label to the darkest ridge; stop if not closer in most cells. Then arm GeoLS + JML vs SUP100, 5 v 5; kill if crack IoU < +0.012 or relP@2 drop > 0.05.
evidence: R: consistent Dice and Hausdorff gains over other soft-labelling methods on three public medical datasets (abstract).
